The sheet is an agent team dashboard, a roster of AI agents coordinated by a Chief of Staff agent, built in AI & Agents Professional. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Chief of Staff"; "Research Analyst · ran 4 tasks"; "Operations Assistant · 1 waiting". One small solid black printed block behind the "1 waiting" status, its text knocked out in white.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Monochrome only, gallery-quality print photography.
